card.name: Start of a new label sentence or section
card.fires_on: The word or mark right where a new sentence, citation or label section begins, such as the period after 'website', 'Advise' in a repeated pregnancy line, or 'Available at'.

modes.label: Citation endings
modes.description: The period or 'at' in reference lists just before a web address.
modes.example: Alternative Treatments website<<.>> Available at: http://www.ebs

modes.label: Advise in pregnancy lines
modes.description: The ending 'ise' of 'Advise' starting the sentence about females of reproductive potential.
modes.example: Advise pregnant women of the potential risk to a fetus. Adv<<ise>> females of reproductive potential to use effective contraception

modes.label: Section heading words
modes.description: First word of a heading or phrase after a cross-reference or inside a heading.

card.plain: It fires at the point where a new sentence or heading in a drug label or reference list is about to start.
